source.outcome_status: opened during source selection; no result from this study is confirmatory
source.time_status: GitHub pull-request createdAt projection; source-time counterfactual only

research_contract.target: Test whether a repository-local semantic coreset robust to stationary history and recent semantic drift predicts future Task cohorts better than full history.
research_contract.runtime_boundary: Selection consumes Tasks from exactly one target repository. Multiple repositories are independent research evaluation units and never form a runtime Task Pool.
research_contract.primary_baseline: all eligible historical Tasks from the target repository
research_contract.sampling_calibration: equal-budget random subsets from the same target-repository history
research_contract.primary_outcome_loss: mean over the complete 3-harness by 12-model configuration panel of absolute selected-history versus future-cohort pass-rate error
research_contract.primary_estimand: configuration mean, then Origin mean within repository, then equal-weight repository mean of candidate-minus-full-history loss
research_contract.task_space_diagnostic: linear-kernel MMD squared between the selected and future mean normalized embedding vectors, contrasted with full history
research_contract.claim_boundary: Passing can nominate one fixed candidate for independent confirmation. It cannot establish strict historical deployability, prospective validity, or a Runner default.
non_solutions: mixing Tasks from several repositories into one Selection
using Agent outcomes, patches, tests, hints, or future Task text in Selection
searching another budget, horizon, recent window, embedding, kernel, objective, or swap rule after joining outcomes
treating task-space similarity as Agent-outcome validity
opening the six-Agent SWE-bench holdout from a failed or conditional result
adding an embedding service, trainer registry, multi-repository Runner, or new core Selector family

task_content_projection.source_paths: the exact 39-path allowlist in the bound Multi-SWE contract
task_content_projection.serialization: Issue #<number> newline <title> blank-line <body>; separate issues with newline-newline---newline-newline
task_content_projection.source_verification: Every downloaded source file must match the Git LFS SHA-256 object identity at the bound dataset revision before its projection is admitted.
task_content_projection.artifact_policy: Raw source files, text projections, and embeddings remain ignored. Commit only small manifests, digests, aggregate results, and membership digests.

embedding.reason: Reuse the previously pinned local ALG-007 representation; do not create a second representation search.

rolling_origin.deep_definition: at least five complete Origins under the corresponding horizon

candidate.name: minimax temporal semantic herding
candidate.information_set: normalized embeddings of eligible historical issue text from the target repository only
uncertainty_targets: mean embedding of all eligible history
mean embedding of the latest h historical Tasks, where h equals the frozen future Task horizon
candidate.rule: Starting empty, add the remaining historical Task minimizing the maximum squared Euclidean distance from the new selected mean to the two uncertainty targets.
candidate.weights: ten selected Tasks with equal weight
candidate.theory: For a linear kernel, mean distance is MMD. The minimax target hedges between stationarity and persistence of recent semantic drift without choosing a mixture weight from outcomes.

controls.role: ablation targeting only the full-history embedding mean with the same greedy rule and no swaps
unchanged transfer control using the latest-15 centroid, greedy kernel-mean selection, and at most 20 improving one-for-one swaps

data_requirements: at least 95 percent of all Tasks have nonempty projected issue text
every eligible repository has at least 80 percent nonempty projected issue text
all admitted source bytes, Task identities, times, embeddings, and memberships match recorded digests
primary_h5_requirements: candidate macro-repository MMD squared is at most 90 percent of full-history macro loss
at least 10 of 13 repositories have negative candidate-minus-full-history difference
every leave-one-repository-out macro difference is negative
candidate macro loss is lower than recency, stationary semantic herding, and unchanged ALG-007
candidate is better than at least 75 percent of 20000 equal-budget random draws
500-permutation within-repository time-order null has corrected lower-tail rate below 0.10
h10_sensitivity_requirements: common-11 macro candidate-minus-full-history difference is negative
at least 8 of 11 repositories have negative difference
candidate is not below the random median
task_space_gate.decision_use: Failure blocks nomination but not the single predeclared outcome evaluation. Outcome improvement without this gate is unexplained exploratory evidence.

decision_order: H5 full-history effect and repository directions
temporal null only if all cheaper requirements pass
requirements: H5 wide macro difference is at most -0.010
at least 10 of 13 H5 repositories have negative difference
every H5 leave-one-repository-out macro difference is negative
H5 deep macro difference is negative
H10 common-11 macro difference is negative with at least 8 of 11 repositories negative
H10 deep macro difference is negative
H5 is better than at least 75 percent of 20000 equal-budget random draws and H10 is not below the random median
language-first macro is negative, at least 5 of 7 languages are negative, and no language difference exceeds +0.020
at least 9 of 12 leave-one-model views are negative
provider-family-first macro is negative, at least 5 of 7 provider families are negative, and no provider-family difference exceeds +0.020
at least 26 of 36 configuration directions are negative
H5 macro loss is lower than unchanged ALG-007
if reached, 2000 within-repository time-order permutations give corrected lower-tail rate below 0.10
outcome_gate.uncertainty: Report repository-cluster paired 95 percent bootstrap interval; a fully negative interval is reserved for later confirmation rather than required for opened-data nomination.
outcome_gate.multiple_comparisons: One new mechanism, one version, H5 primary, H10 sensitivity, and one unchanged ALG-007 control. No outcome-driven variant can inherit nomination status.

agent_groups.transfer_semantics: Selection is outcome-free, so Agent-group audits reuse the exact frozen memberships and evaluate only the held-out group. Tests must prove candidate materialization accepts no Agent outcomes.

report: model, provider, harness, and configuration directions

authority.allowed_network: download and verify the exact pinned public dataset source only
authority.allowed_runtime: local CPU and the already-cached pinned embedding model
authority.implementation_scope: direct Multi-SWE experiment code, tests, ignored raw artifacts, and small committed evidence only
